newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Coast Dental rated buy, stock rises.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Coast Dental rated buy, stock rises.

text.p: Coast Dental Services Inc shares on Wednesday were rated a buy "for higher-risk accounts" by Robert W. Baird & Co Inc.
-- By early afternoon, the shares were 1-3/8 higher at 17, a fresh high.
-- The Tampa Bay, Florida-based company, which manages dental practices, made its initial public stock offering in February, selling shares at $8 each.

-- The company "is becoming dominant in its key markets," said Baird, which expects Coast Dental's earnings to jump 120 percent to $0.53 a share in 1997. The number of centers operated by Coast Dental is expected to grow to 56 by the end of 1997 from 29 at the end of last year.
-- Baird expects 1998 earnings of $0.80 a share, with the company to maintain a 40 to 50 percent growth rate for several years.
